text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(…Today is… the last day of the Summer
Training Camp.
Did… I even learn anything substantial?
Was I able to get stronger?.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …Trainer is… always praising me and…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Hearing him say that does make me happy,
but the thing is… I can't say I can take
his praise with my head held high.
How would I even—)

text_block_list.name: Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey over here! There's a festival today!
They just put a flier on the bulletin
board!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wha!

text_block_list.name: Uma Musume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
we have to go!!
We worked hard on this training camp,
I wonder if my trainer will treat me as a
reward～

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …This is the answer!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(In order to change myself… I need to take
that first step.
I need to be brave… and go towards the
starting line! It starts with me!)

Stalls lined the streets,
with the bright lamps and music enveloping
the surroundings.
And I can feel the mood rising with the
sound of taiko drums in the distance.
choice_data_list: Looks fun, thanks for inviting me!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-not at all! Um… I guess,
you're welcome. 
I should be the one… saying thank you…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…Haaa. I invited them, I actually invited them,
and yet!
What should we do?
I wonder what I can do so they can enjoy
themselves.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(…No! Since it's me,
I know how to have fun at a festival!
Just like the other children,
today will be tons of fun!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-trainer, let's go play… together! Ah,
look! The crowd at that stall cleared up.

—Katanuki.
Since I broke mine in half a while ago,
I was watching Cheval meticulously chip away
at the etched image.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Hm… Almost… 
…Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry trainer! 
I got too invested in the game,
something like this must be boring to you—
choice_data_list: That concentration is a strong point!
That concentration is a strong point!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…Aah.
U-up next is… something that will get our
blood pumping!
Something so exciting that it'll get our
hearts racing!

— String Pulling Lottery. 
Even though the prizes were aimed at children,
it certainly gave that blood pumping
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-now then!
Can you please tell me what item you want!?
I will… do my best to get that item!
choice_data_list: Alright, then that box of candy there…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Hmm… there's a couple strings to pull from…
this string is different in the back.
And this one here is a bit longer than the
rest…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
And there's also… this one has a stiffer
feeling to it, and that one is…

text_block_list.name: Man Running the Lottery
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! Lil' missy,
for something like this you trust in your
gut and go for it!
There's a line formin' behind ya,
so I gotta ask ya to pull one now!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah… um, s-sorry! 
T-then I'll pull this one—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I didn't get… the box of candy…)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ah… why am I like this? 
…I look totally lame…)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(…Even after finding the courage to take
the lead, this is all it amounts to.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer is probably… no they're definitely
disappointed in me. I knew it,
compared to my sisters I—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh?

When I recalled how serious Cheval was just
a moment ago,
I couldn't help but break out into a
laugh.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-trainer? What's wrong? 
A-are you finally fed up with me!?

After apologizing for laughing like that,
I told her that it was just like her to act
that serious.
I had fun and enjoyed myself.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: You… enjoyed that?

I nodded.
I told her that she was doing everything so
seriously all for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer is… someone who always accepts who
I am… even though I don't shine
whatsoever.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(…Even though you're from the "other side"…you
still stand right by me.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…Trainer,
someday you might… come to regret this.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I was… the one to choose you. 
And yet, you still accepted it…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty of sparkling uma musumes and
they all… shine much brighter than me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I knew that… I knew that but… I… I
couldn't…

Her voice was started to quiver in fear.
I needed to calm her down,
it was clear she had a lot of anxiety weighing
on her. So I—
choice_data_list: I wouldn't say that's quite the case.

text_block_list.text: I shot down what she was saying.
choice_data_list: I'm the one that chose you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Hah—
That's the reason why I had no regrets.

I'm glad I chose her. Every time I saw Cheval,
those words would pop into my mind.
Seeing her work hard, every single day,
only made me more confident in those
words.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …T-Trainer…

(…I… couldn't love myself,
the me that always hung her head low.)
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(—And yet, in their eyes, I was "something",
something that shines and sparkled.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ( Ah… If that's the case, I'd need to—)
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it our all bac...

text_block_list.text:
("Trainer who believes in me"… 
I want to… believe in them too)
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…Understood, trainer. 
I will… give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (And then… someday, I want to ask them.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Just what were you able to see in me… 
In those eyes of yours?)
